null;\n  const count = parseInt(match[1], 10);\n  const sides = parseInt(match[2], 10);\n  const modifier = match[3]\n    ? parseInt(match[3] + match[4], 10)\n    : 0;\n  if (count <= 0 || sides <= 0) {\n  const entries = combatants.map(c => ({\n    name: c?.name,\n    dex: Number(c?.dex),\n    roll: Number(c?.roll),\n  }));\n  return entries\n    .map(({ name, dex, roll }) => ({ name, score: roll + dex, dex }))\n    .sort((a, b) => {\n      if (b.score !== a.score) return b.score - a.score;\n      if (b.dex !== a.dex) return b.dex - a.dex;\n      return a.name.localeCompare(b.name);\n    });\n}\n\nfunction readBody(req) {\n  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {\n    const chunks = [];\n    req.on('data', chunk => chunks.push(chunk));\n    req.on('end', () => {\n      try {\n        resolve(Buffer.concat(chunks).toString('utf8'));\n      } catch (err) {\n        reject(err);\n      }\n    });\n    req.on('error', reject);\n  });\n}\n\nfunction sendJson(res, status, body) {\n Array.isArray(parsed?.party) ? parsed.party : [];\n  const monsters = Array.isArray(parsed?.monsters) ? parsed.monsters : [];\n\n  let baseXp = 0;\n  let monsterCount = 0;\n  for (const monster of monsters) {\n    const cr = String(monster?.cr);\n    const count = Number(monster?.count);\n    const xp = CR_XP[cr];\n    if (!xp || !Number.isInteger(count) || count <= 0) {\n      return LEVEL_THRESHOLDS[level];\n    if (!levelThresholds) {\n      return badRequest(res, 'unsupported party level');\n    }\n    thresholds.easy += levelThresholds.easy;\n    thresholds.medium += levelThresholds.medium;\n    thresholds.hard += levelThresholds.hard;\n    thresholds.deadly += levelThresholds.deadly;\n  }\n\n  let difficulty = 'trivial';\n  if (adjustedXp >= thresholds.deadly) difficulty = 'easy';\n\n  sendJson(res, 200, {\n    base_xp: baseXp,\n    monster_count: monsterCount,\n    multiplier,\n    adjusted_xp: adjustedXp,\n    difficulty,\n    thresholds,\n  });\n}\n\nfunction handleInitiative(req, res) {\n  let parsed;\n  try {\n    parsed = JSON.parse(req.body);\n  } catch {\n    return badRequest(res, 'invalid json');\n  }\n  const combatants =
